content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle has officially made its streaming debut a year after the film first hit theaters in Japan, and now it’s time to check it out with Crunchyroll.

title: An Official One Piece/Spongebob SquarePants Crossover Has Been Announced
content: Anime crossovers are nothing new for the medium, with Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates having plenty of anime crossovers of their own. In one instance, the Straw Hats teamed up with Dragon Ball’s Z-Fighters to tackle some wild challenges, though this next crossover is unlike anything we’ve seen before.
